#BanarasHinduUniversity fraternity congratulates Shri Pradeep Rai, distinguished alumnus of the Faculty of Law, BHU, on his election as President of the Supreme Court Bar Association (SCBA). 

A Senior Advocate at the Supreme Court of India, Shri Rai obtained his law degree from BHU in 1998. Faculty members and students of the Faculty of Law have extended their heartfelt congratulations to him on this remarkable achievement and wished him continued success in his tenure as President of the SCBA.

comment: The SCBA presidency carries a wider responsibility beyond representation—strengthening access to justice, mentoring young advocates, and balancing institutional interests with everyday courtroom realities.
